language_codes.provenance: Tesseract traineddata codes for the two languages of the owner's courses (French and English, preferences.md). fra and eng are the files of the tessdata_fast set installed with Tesseract 5.5.3 (winget tesseract-ocr.tesseract), verified 2026-11-16. The ambiguous entry lists both codes for a document whose language cannot be decided (spec R6).

tessdata_env_var.provenance: Environment variable that PyMuPDF get_tessdata reads for the Tesseract language folder (pymupdf/__init__.py, read 2026-11-16, and spec Constraints).

tesseract_tool_name.provenance: Name of the OCR engine used in refusal messages (spec R10). tesseract.exe is not on PATH; PyMuPDF performs the OCR once TESSDATA_PREFIX is set (verified by the session 2026-11-16).

ocr_probe_word.provenance: Fixed fictitious word written into the image of the preflight probe (spec R10). Chosen by the author; it carries no content of any report.

ocr_probe_font_size.provenance: Font size in points of the probe word, large enough for the probe to be read at the probe resolution. Chosen by the author, not measured.

ocr_probe_dpi.provenance: Resolution in dots per inch of the probe image and of the OCR call. 300 dpi is the usual resolution for printed text; chosen by the author, not measured on this machine.
